# `aitbc config set`

Set a configuration value in the local or global config file.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc config set [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--key` | text | — | yes | The Key. |
| `--value` | text | — | yes | The Value. |
| `--global` | flag | `false` | no | Set global config |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc config set --key <key> --value <value>
```
